item.title: People Power Party: "If Ahn Kyu-baek Does Not Disclose Military Records, We Will Impeach" (국민의힘 “안규백, 병적 기록 공개 안 하면 탄핵할 것”)
item.description:
People Power Party: "If Ahn Kyu-baek Does Not Disclose Military Records, We Will Impeach" (국민의힘 “안규백, 병적 기록 공개 안 하면 탄핵할 것”)

Regarding the allegations that Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek deserted during his service as a conscripted guard, the People Power Party stated on the 12th, "If Minister Ahn does not disclose his military service records to clear up the suspicions or resign voluntarily, we will pursue impeachment." (안규백 국방부 장관이 방위병 복무 시절 군무 이탈을 했다는 의혹과 관련해 국민의힘은 12일 “안 장관이 병적 기록부를 공개해 의혹을 해소하거나 자진 사퇴하지 않는다면 탄핵 소추에 나설 것”이라고 했다.)

People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon said in a written commentary that day, "The head of the Ministry of National Defense, who should establish discipline among the 450,000 South Korean troops and be responsible for national security, is shaking the entire country over suspicions of his own past 'desertion.'" (최보윤 국민의힘 수석대변인은 이날 서면 논평에서 “대한민국 45만 국군의 기강을 확립하고 국가 안보를 책임져야 할 국방부 수장이, 정작 과거 자신의 ‘탈영 의혹’으로 온 나라를 뒤흔들고 있다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Choi claimed, "The allegation that Minister Ahn went AWOL for seven months during his time as a conscripted guard has been exposed with specific testimonies, and public outrage is spreading uncontrollably." He added, "The exposed content is shockingly detailed. The allegations of 'seven months of AWOL, being taken by the military police arrest squad, 30 days in the guardhouse, and eight additional months of service' are very precise. The whistleblower, Kim Young-soo, head of the Public Interest Reporting Center, has stepped forward confidently, staking his position, saying, 'If it's false, I'll accept any punishment' and 'Sue me for defamation.'" (최 수석대변인은 “안 장관의 방위병 시절 7개월 무단 탈영 의혹이 구체적인 증언과 함께 폭로되며 국민적 분노가 걷잡을 수 없이 확산되고 있다”고 주장했다. 그는 “폭로된 내용은 충격적일 만큼 구체적”이라며 “‘7개월 무단 탈영, 헌병대 체포조 연행, 30일 영창, 8개월 추가 복무’라는 의혹은 매우 정교하다. 의혹을 제기한 김영수 공익신고센터장은 ‘허위 사실이라면 어떠한 처벌도 받겠다’ ‘나를 명예훼손으로 고소하라’며 직을 걸고 당당하게 나서고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding these allegations, the Ministry of National Defense stated on the 10th that they are "clearly false," explaining that the record of eight additional months of service is due to an error in the military records, and that Minister Ahn plans to request a correction of the military record error after his term as minister ends. However, they said Minister Ahn will not disclose his military records or request a correction during his term. (이 의혹에 대해 국방부는 지난 10일 “명백한 허위”라며 8개월 추가 복무 기록은 병적 기록이 잘못된 것이고, 안 장관이 장관 임기가 끝나면 병적 기록 오류에 대해 정정을 청구할 계획이라고 밝혔다. 그러나 안 장관이 병적 기록을 공개하거나, 임기 중에 병적 기록 정정 청구를 하지는 않을 것이라고 했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Choi evaluated this explanation, saying, "Minister Ahn only repeats a detached rhetoric, claiming to be a 'victim of military administration,' and continues to remain silent, hiding 'a single sheet of military record' that could instantly resolve the suspicions." He then asked, "Could the personal military record of a defense minister who was a conscripted guard be a military secret that shakes national security?" and added, "If he has nothing to hide, there is absolutely no reason not to disclose it." (최 수석대변인은 이런 해명에 대해 “안 장관은 ‘병무 행정의 피해자’라는 유체 이탈 화법만 반복할 뿐, 의혹을 단번에 해소할 ‘병적 기록부 단 한 장’을 끝내 숨긴 채 침묵으로 일관하고 있다”고 평가했다. 그러면서 “방위병 출신 국방장관의 개인 병적 기록부가 국가 안보를 뒤흔들 군사 기밀이라도 되느냐”며 “떳떳하다면 공개하지 못할 이유가 전혀 없다”고 했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Choi continued, "If these allegations are true, it would mean a deserter once chased by an arrest squad is now commanding the military police and 450,000 troops who once hunted him," calling it "the worst disgrace in South Korean military history and a complete subversion of national discipline." (최 수석대변인은 이어서 “만약 이 의혹이 사실이라면, 과거 탈영병 체포조에 쫓기던 도망자가 자신을 쫓던 군사경찰과 45만 장병을 지휘하는 셈”이라며 “대한민국 군 역사상 최악의 수치이자 국기 문란”이라고 했다.)

He further assessed, "In particular, if Minister Ahn's desertion is proven true, his explanations during the past confirmation hearing would be a massive deception, thoroughly tricking the public and the National Assembly." He added, "If the presidential office knew of this critical flaw and pushed through his appointment anyway, it amounts to a dereliction of national defense and abuse of state affairs." (또 “특히 안 장관의 군무 이탈이 사실로 드러난다면, 지난 인사청문회에서의 해명은 국민과 국회를 철저히 기만한 대국민 사기극”이라고 평가했다. 이어 “청와대가 이러한 치명적 결함을 알고도 장관 임명을 강행했다면, 이는 국방 안보를 내팽개친 국정 농단과 다름없다”고 했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Choi claimed, "Moreover, the public is appalled at Minister Ahn's behavior of using the integration of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies as a shield to cover up his own flaws, pushing through a hasty reform of the 100-year military framework." Pointing out that over 300,000 citizens have signed a petition to the National Assembly calling for Minister Ahn's impeachment, he said, "Minister Ahn, who has lost even the minimum moral qualification to establish military discipline and lead security policy, can no longer perform his duties." (최 수석대변인은 “더욱이 안 장관이 자신의 흠결을 덮기 위한 방패막이로 육·해·공군 사관학교 통폐합이라는, 100년 국방의 뼈대를 졸속으로 밀어붙이는 행태에 국민은 경악하고 있다”고 주장했다. 최 수석대변인은 안 장관을 탄핵 소추해 달라는 대국회 청원에 참여한 국민이 30만명을 넘어섰다는 점을 지적하면서, “군의 기강을 세우고 안보 정책을 이끌기 위한 최소한의 도덕적 자격조차 상실한 안 장관은 더 이상 직무를 수행할 수 없다”고도 했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Choi then demanded, "Minister Ahn should immediately disclose his military records before the public." He stated, "If there is no resolution of the suspicions or voluntary resignation, the National Assembly will immediately proceed with impeachment in accordance with the stern command of the people." <<>> (최 수석대변인은 그러면서 “안 장관은 당장 국민 앞에 병적 기록부를 공개하라”고 요구했다. 그는 “만약 의혹 해소도, 자진 사퇴도 없다면 국회는 국민의 엄중한 명령에 따라 즉각 탄핵 소추에 나설 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Ahn Cheol-soo "Opposes Han Dong-hoon's Return to the Party… Don't Even Come Near the People Power Party" (안철수 “한동훈 복당 반대…국민의힘에 얼씬도 하지 말라”)
item.description:
Ahn Cheol-soo "Opposes Han Dong-hoon's Return to the Party… Don't Even Come Near the People Power Party" (안철수 “한동훈 복당 반대…국민의힘에 얼씬도 하지 말라”)

People Power Party lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo expressed his opposition to independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon's return to the People Power Party on the 12th. (국민의힘 안철수 의원은 12일 무소속 한동훈 의원의 국민의힘 복당을 반대한다는 뜻을 밝혔다.)

In a press conference at the National Assembly that day, Ahn stated, "I had been keeping the possibility of Han Dong-hoon's return to the party open, but after his testimony as a witness in the trial of Daegu Mayor Choo Kyeong-ho, I encountered a reaction I never imagined. I got a preview of how chaotic the party could become if Han Dong-hoon returns." <<> Previously, Ahn testified as a witness in the trial of Mayor Choo Kyeong-ho, who was the People Power Party's floor leader during the December 3 martial law incident, stating that he understood Han Dong-hoon, then party leader, was the first to notify People Power Party lawmakers to gather at the party headquarters rather than the National Assembly. In response, Han rebutted this as a "distortion of facts," sparking a battle over the truth. <<> Ahn said, "I heard from those who were gathered at the party headquarters at the time that it was Representative Han Dong-hoon who first suggested going to the party headquarters, and later confirmed this through official party documents. Yet, Han Dong-hoon has portrayed me as if I were distorting and inciting." He added, "Turning a truthful testimony into a falsehood is clearly the spread of false information and defamation." <<> Ahn also criticized Han for failing to appear as a witness in the same trial despite being summoned multiple times. Ahn said, "If he has something to say, he should stop hiding behind 'absence due to closed doors' and appear in court to testify. I urge him to formalize his claims by testifying in court, even now." <<> Ahn remarked, "Han Dong-hoon participated in preventing the December 3 martial law, but he alone did not stop the martial law that night. Our party lawmakers were also present at the voting site, and those who remained at the party headquarters and missed the vote jointly issued a statement opposing the martial law. So why must that day's history become a heroic narrative solely for Han Dong-hoon?" <<> He added, "Is it acceptable to attack a fellow lawmaker who testified truthfully to protect his own narrative, even if it means the People Power Party is branded as a 'insurrection party'? If he's already causing this much trouble while outside the party, it's as clear as day what will happen if he returns." <<> He concluded, "I ask that Han refrain from even coming near our party from now on. If he's considering forming a new party, I'd support that." (안 의원은 이날 국회 기자회견에서 “저는 그동안 한동훈 의원의 복당 가능성을 열어 두고 있었지만 이번에 추경호 대구시장 재판에 증인으로 진술한 후 상상도 하지 못했던 반응을 접했다”며 “한동훈 의원이 복당한다면 당이 어떻게 혼란에 휩싸일지, 그 예고편을 목격할 수 있었다”고 했다.)

item.title: 65.5% in Reform Party Poll Say "Prosecutors Should Directly Conduct Supplementary Investigations" (“보완수사, 검사가 직접 해야” 65.5% 개혁신당 여론조사)
item.description:
65.5% in Reform Party Poll Say "Prosecutors Should Directly Conduct Supplementary Investigations" (“보완수사, 검사가 직접 해야” 65.5% 개혁신당 여론조사)

A public opinion poll has shown that more than 6 out of 10 citizens believe that when deficiencies are found in police investigations and additional probes are needed, "prosecutors should directly investigate." As the Democratic Party of Korea pushes forward with a bill to abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority and allow them to request supplementary investigations from the police, the public appears to view that "it is more appropriate for prosecutors to conduct the investigation." (국민 10명 중 6명 이상은 경찰 수사에서 부족한 점이 발견돼 추가 수사가 필요한 경우 ‘검사가 직접 수사해야 한다’고 생각한다는 여론조사 결과가 나왔다. 더불어민주당이 검사의 보완수사권을 폐지하고 경찰에 보완수사를 요구할 수 있게 하는 법안을 추진하는 가운데, 국민들은 ‘검사가 수사하는 게 더 적절하다’고 보고 있다는 것이다.)

According to a 100% wireless RDD ARS automated response survey conducted on the 11th by the Reform Institute under the Reform Party, 65.5% of respondents said "prosecutors should directly investigate" when deficiencies are found in police investigations requiring additional probes. Only 26.5% said "the police should reinvestigate." The response favoring "prosecutors directly investigating" was dominant across all age groups, with the highest rate at 76.5% among those in their 30s. (개혁신당 산하 개혁연구원이 지난 11일 100% 무선 RDD 방식의 ARS 자동응답 조사를 실시한 결과, 경찰 수사에서 부족한 점이 발견돼 추가 수사가 필요한 경우 ‘검사가 직접 수사해야 한다’는 응답이 65.5%로 나왔다. ‘경찰이 다시 수사해야 한다’는 26.5%였다. ‘검사가 직접 수사’ 응답은 모든 연령대에서 우세했고, 특히 30대에서 76.5%로 가장 높았다.)

When suspicions are raised about problems with the police investigation itself, 64.0% responded that "prosecutors should directly investigate," while 29.3% said "other police or the National Investigation Headquarters should investigate." (경찰 수사 자체에 문제가 있다는 의혹이 제기된 경우 ‘검사가 직접 수사해야 한다’는 응답이 64.0%로 나왔다. ‘다른 경찰이나 국가수사본부가 수사해야 한다’는 29.3%로 조사됐다.)

Regarding the so-called "supplementary investigation request" method, where prosecutors request additional probes and police reinvestigate, 49.3% responded that "external checks are difficult to properly implement," while 36.6% said "external checks can be properly implemented." (검사가 추가 수사를 요구하고 경찰이 다시 수사하는 이른바 ‘보완수사 요구’방식에 대해선 ‘외부 견제가 제대로 이뤄지기 어렵다’는 응답이 49.3%로 나타났다. ‘외부 견제가 제대로 이뤄질 수 있다’는 36.6%다.)

Respondents showed high awareness of the case involving the murder of a high school girl in Gwangju, South Jeolla Province (the Jang Yun-gi case), which served as the backdrop for this survey: 78.2% said they "know it well," and 16.1% said they "have heard of it." (응답자들은 이번 조사의 배경이 된 전남광주 여고생 살해 사건(장윤기 사건)에 대해 ‘잘 알고 있다’ 78.2%, ‘들어본 적은 있다’ 16.1% 등 대부분 사건을 인지하고 있는 것으로 나타났다.)

Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, stated, "Nothing that the Democratic Party has pushed through without bipartisan agreement has turned out well. They will face harsh criticism for this (supplementary investigation authority) forced push." (이준석 개혁신당 대표는 “민주당이 여야합의 없이 밀고나간 것 중에 잘된 것이 없다. 이번 (보완수사권) 강행으로 크게 비판받을 것”이라고 했다.)

This survey is a social issue survey, not an election poll, and thus is not subject to reporting to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. However, its design for sampling, weighting, and margin of error calculations follows the standards of general political opinion polls. (이번 조사는 선거여론조사가 아닌 사회 현안 조사로 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 신고 대상이 아니다. 다만 표집과 가중치, 오차범위 산정 등은 일반 정치 여론조사 기준에 준해 설계됐다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: "The judicial system has already collapsed due to the abolition of the prosecution before supplementary investigation powers... It's the Democratic Party regime's responsibility" (한동훈 “보완 수사권 전에 검찰 폐지로 이미 사법 시스템 망가져… 민주당 정권 책임”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon: "The judicial system has already collapsed due to the abolition of the prosecution before supplementary investigation powers... It's the Democratic Party regime's responsibility" (한동훈 “보완 수사권 전에 검찰 폐지로 이미 사법 시스템 망가져… 민주당 정권 책임”)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon has been continuously criticizing the Democratic Party of Korea's push to completely abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. (한동훈 무소속 의원이 더불어민주당이 추진하는 검찰 보완 수사권 완전 폐지에 대해 연일 비판을 거듭하고 있다.)

On the morning of the 12th, Rep. Han shared and criticized a post on Facebook from Democratic Party Gyeonggi Governor Choo Mi-ae, who had written the previous day. In her post, Governor Choo argued, "We must not waver just before the final 9th ridge of prosecution reform," and added, "Even though there may be some distrust and anxiety about entrusting all investigations to the police, we cannot use that as an excuse to delay reform of a prosecution that has usurped democratic constitutionalism." Choo also stated, "While some mention the recent case of a police senior officer allegedly destroying evidence of his son's murder (the Jang Yun-gi case) and argue that the police cannot be fully trusted with investigations and that supplementary investigation powers are essential, the potential misconduct by the police is less severe than the prosecution's history of undermining justice," thereby expressing her opposition to granting the prosecution exceptional supplementary investigation powers. <<> In response, Rep. Han pointed out, "In fact, the judicial system has already been broken by the abolition of the prosecution. The heated debate over whether to abolish supplementary investigation powers is merely a peripheral issue that cannot revive a broken system." <<> Rep. Han added, "The issue of supplementary investigation powers is like 'stabbing someone with a knife to inflict a fatal wound and then debating whether to apply a red ointment.' It's certainly better than nothing, but it cannot restore the system that has been broken." <<> Rep. Han said, "In the world created by the Democratic Party regime, crimes like the Jang Yun-gi case, where evidence is buried and covered up, will proliferate. Ordinary citizens won't get back money they're owed, and the principle of 'money buys innocence, poverty buys guilt' will become routine." <<> He continued, "It's the Democratic Party regime's responsibility. We must rebuild conservatism, achieve a landslide victory in the 2028 general election, and restore the country to normalcy." <<> The previous day, Rep. Han also referenced the Jang Yun-gi case, noting, "Prosecutors are transferred nationwide every two years (or every year for those at the deputy chief level or above) and are generally barred from serving in their home regions under a conflict-of-interest system. In contrast, the police have no nationwide rotation requirement, and officers often serve in their home regions for over a decade." <<> Regarding this, he argued, "In a world created by the Democratic Party, where police who have worked together long-term in one place monopolize investigations without any oversight, incidents like a second or third Jang Yun-gi case are inevitable. Now, even within a fearful Democratic Party, absurd infighting is occurring—'We'll end up taking all the blame,' or 'We're just elevating Han Dong-hoon with this.'" <<> Rep. Han then said, "So go ahead, try it—abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers and see what happens." <<> (한 의원은 12일 오전 페이스북에 민주당 추미애 경기지사가 전날 페이스북에 올린 글을 공유하고 비판했다. 추 지사는 글에서 “검찰 개혁 마지막 9부 능선을 앞두고 흔들리면 안 된다”며 “경찰의 수사 전담에 대한 불신과 불안이 없지 않다고 해도, 이를 민주 헌정을 찬탈한 검찰에 대한 개혁을 미룰 핑계로 삼을 수는 없다”고 주장했다. 추 지사는 “최근 경찰 간부가 아들이 저지른 살인 사건의 증거를 인멸한 의혹 사건(장윤기 사건)을 거론하면서, 경찰에 수사를 전적으로 맡길 수 없고 보완 수사권이 반드시 필요하다고 주장하나, 경찰이 일으킬 수 있는 사고는 검찰이 정의를 훼손해 온 것에 비하면 덜하다”며 검찰에 예외적으로 보완 수사권을 주자는 의견에 반대한다는 뜻을 밝혔다.)

item.title: North Korea, ahead of premier-level talks with China, says "bilateral friendship has reached new heights" (北, 중국과 총리 회담 전하며 “양국 친선 관계 새로운 높이에 올라서”)
item.description:
North Korea, ahead of premier-level talks with China, says "bilateral friendship has reached new heights" (北, 중국과 총리 회담 전하며 “양국 친선 관계 새로운 높이에 올라서”)

North Korea's Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 12th that Premier Pak Thae-song, during a meeting with Chinese Premier Li Qiang at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing the previous day, stated that "the DPRK-China friendly relations have reached a new height." (북한 조선중앙통신은 12일 박태성 내각총리가 전날 중국 베이징 인민대회당에서 리창 국무원 총리와 회담하며 “조·중(북·중) 친선 관계가 새로운 높이에 올라섰다”고 말했다고 보도했다.)

Pak Thae-song is visiting China from the 10th to the 12th at the invitation of the Chinese government to mark the 65th anniversary of the signing of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance (Friendship and Cooperation Treaty). Pak met with Chinese President Xi Jinping on the 10th and was honored at a banquet commemorating the Friendship and Cooperation Treaty. He then attended anniversary events on the 11th before holding talks with Premier Li. (박태성은 11일 북·중 우호 협조 및 상호 원조 조약(우호 협력 조약) 체결 65주년을 계기로 중국 정부 초청을 받아 지난 10일부터 12일까지 중국을 방문 중이다. 박태성은 지난 10일 시진핑 중국 국가주석을 접견했고 우호 협력 조약 기념 연회에서 중국 측의 예우를 받았다. 이어 11일 기념 행사에 참석한 뒤 리 총리와 회담했다.)

According to KCNA, Pak told Premier Li that "the DPRK-China Friendship Treaty is a solid political and legal guarantee that strongly drives the development of friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries." He added, "The complex and challenging international political situation demands that the two parties and two countries continue to highly uphold the spirit of the treaty, which centers on unity, cooperation, and the protection of common interests, for the victorious advance of the socialist cause." (통신에 따르면, 박태성은 리 총리에게 “조·중 우호 조약은 두 나라 사이의 친선·협조 관계 발전을 강력히 추동해 나가는 굳건한 정치적·법률적 담보”라며 “복잡다단한 국제 정치 정세는 두 당, 두 나라가 사회주의 위업의 승리적 전진을 위해 단결과 협조, 공동의 이익 수호를 핵으로 하는 조약의 정신을 계속 높이 발양해 나갈 것을 요구하고 있다”고 했다.)

He further stated, "Thanks to the direct attention and wise leadership of Comrade Kim Jong Un and Comrade Xi Jinping, the DPRK-China friendly relations have today risen to a new height." (이어 “김정은 동지와 시진핑 동지의 직접적인 관심과 현명한 영도에 의해, 오늘 조·중 친선 관계는 새로운 높이에 올라섰다”고 했다.)

Pak emphasized, "Carrying forward the noble intentions of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries, we will actively strive to continuously strengthen and develop DPRK-China friendship and unity." (그러면서 “두 당, 두 나라 최고 수뇌 분들의 숭고한 의도를 받들어 조·중 친선 단결을 끊임없이 강화·발전시켜 나가기 위해 적극 노력할 것”이라고 강조했다.)

Premier Li said, "China and the DPRK are close neighbors sharing a common destiny, protecting and helping each other." He noted, "General Secretary Xi Jinping made a state visit to the DPRK and reached important common understandings with general secretary Kim Jong Un on deepening China-DPRK relations and provided strategic guidance." (리 총리는 “중국과 조선은 운명을 함께하고 서로 지켜주고 도와주는 인방”이라며 “시진핑 총서기 동지가 조선을 국가 방문해 김정은 총비서 동지와 중·조 관계를 심화시키는 문제와 관련한 중요한 공동 인식을 이룩하고 전략적 지침을 마련했다”고 말했다.)

Premier Li continued, "Properly safeguarding, consolidating, and developing China-DPRK relations has always been the unwavering policy of the Chinese Party and government." He expressed China's willingness to "continue adhering to the spirit of the China-DPRK Friendship Treaty, maintain close high-level exchanges, expand and develop political mutual trust and practical cooperation, thereby enhancing the well-being of the two peoples and actively contributing to regional and world peace and development." (리 총리는 이어 “중·조 관계를 훌륭히 수호하고 훌륭히 공고히 하며 훌륭히 발전시키는 것은 시종일관 중국 당과 정부의 확고부동한 방침”이라고 전하면서 “중·조 우호 조약의 정신을 계속 견지해 고위급 내왕(왕래)을 긴밀히 하며 정치적 호상(상호) 신뢰와 실용적인 협조를 확대·발전시킴으로써 두 나라 인민의 복리를 증진시키고 지역과 세계의 평화적 발전에 적극 기여할 용의가 있다”고 했다.)

KCNA reported that "the talks discussed issues related to expanding and developing exchanges and cooperation in various fields, in accordance with the agreements reached by the top leaders of the DPRK and China during their historic meeting in Pyongyang." (통신은 “회담에서는 조·중 최고 수뇌 분들께서 역사적인 평양 상봉에서 이룩하신 합의에 따라 각 분야에서의 교류와 협력을 확대·발전시켜 나가기 위한 문제들이 토의됐다”고 전했다.)

The agency also noted, "The talks were held in a comradely and friendly atmosphere, and Premier Li Qiang hosted a banquet to welcome the delegation of the Party and government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea." (통신은 “회담은 동지적이며 친선적인 분위기 속에서 진행됐고, 리창 총리는 조선민주주의인민공화국 당 및 정부 대표단을 환영해 연회를 차렸다”고도 전했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "Goodbye to Stagnation Theory... Korea's Economy Redrawing Its Long-Term Trend Line" (김용범 “바이바이 정체론... 한국 경제, 장기 추세선 다시 그리고 있다”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom: "Goodbye to Stagnation Theory... Korea's Economy Redrawing Its Long-Term Trend Line" (김용범 “바이바이 정체론... 한국 경제, 장기 추세선 다시 그리고 있다”)

Kim Yong-beom, Chief of the Presidential Office for Policy, stated on the 12th, "South Korea is no longer on its past trend line," adding, "The market is redrawing the long-term trend line for Korea's economy." (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 12일 “한국은 더 이상 과거의 추세선 위에 있지 않다”며 “시장은 한국 경제의 장기 추세선을 다시 그리고 있다”고 했다.)

Chief Kim made this remark in a Facebook post titled "Goodbye to East Asian Stagnation Theory." He argued that the AI production revolution, the semiconductor supercycle, and government-led capital market reforms could propel South Korea's economy into a long-term growth trajectory. (김 실장은 이날 페이스북에 ‘바이바이 동아시아 정체론’이라는 제목의 글을 올리며 이같이 밝혔다. 인공지능(AI) 생산혁명과 반도체 슈퍼사이클, 정부 주도의 자본시장 개혁을 계기로 한국 경제가 장기 성장 추세로 돌입할 수 있다는 것이다.)

Chief Kim assessed the period of 2022–2024 under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration as "bleak" and "closer to decline than growth." He noted, "The semiconductor downcycle suppressed exports, and the KOSPI's correlation with the U.S. stock market broke down, leading to prolonged sluggishness," adding, "The Legoland incident triggered real estate PF risks, and political turmoil compounded the situation by late 2024." (김 실장은 윤석열 정부 때인 2022~2024년은 “암울했다” “성장보다 쇠퇴에 가까웠다”고 평가했다. 그는 “반도체 다운사이클이 수출을 짓눌렀고, 코스피는 미국 증시와의 동조 흐름이 깨지며 장기간 부진했다”며 “레고랜드 사태로 부동산 PF 리스크가 불거졌고, 2024년 말에는 정치적 혼란까지 겹쳤다”고 했다.)

However, he claimed that the atmosphere changed starting in the second half of 2025, when the Lee Jae-myung administration took office. He said, "As political uncertainty was resolved and policy directions were clarified, memory demand, data center investments, advanced packaging, and power infrastructure expansion all aligned simultaneously, rapidly reviving exports and corporate profits," and "the trend line began to shift direction." (그런데 이재명 정부가 들어선 2025년 하반기부터 분위기가 달라졌다고 주장했다. 그는 “정치적 불확실성이 수습되고 정책 방향이 정리되던 그 시점에 메모리 수요, 데이터센터 투자, 첨단 패키징, 전력 인프라 확대가 한꺼번에 맞물리며 수출과 기업이익이 빠르게 살아났다”며 “추세선이 방향을 바꾸기 시작했다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Growth forecasts were revised upward consecutively, and South Korea began to be reassessed as the country expected to achieve the highest growth rate among advanced nations in 2026–2027," adding, "It's hard to see this as a mere rebound. The market is redrawing Korea's long-term trend line." (이어 “성장률 전망은 연이어 상향됐고, 한국은 2026~2027년 선진국 가운데 가장 높은 성장률이 예상되는 국가로 재평가되기 시작했다”며 “이것을 단순한 반등으로만 보기는 어렵다. 시장은 한국 경제의 장기 추세선을 다시 그리고 있다”고 했다.)

Chief Kim stated, "The magnitude of upward growth adjustments, the speed of capital market reassessment, and the intensity of policy and industrial cycles aligning are at levels rarely seen in Korea's economy in recent decades," explaining, "This is why the changes now occurring should be viewed not as a simple economic recovery, but as an initial phase showing the potential for a shift in the long-term trend itself." (김 실장은 “성장률 전망의 상향폭, 자본시장 재평가의 속도, 정책과 산업 사이클이 맞물린 강도는 최근 수십 년 한국 경제에서 쉽게 찾아보기 어려운 수준”이라며 “지금 나타나는 변화를 단순한 경기 회복이 아니라 장기 추세 자체가 달라질 가능성을 보여주는 초기 국면으로 읽어야 하는 이유”라고 했다.)

Chief Kim remarked, "Explaining this turnaround solely by semiconductors would miss the most important part," citing the government's announced 'Three Major Mega Projects,' amendments to the Commercial Act, treasury stock system reforms, and the National Growth Fund. He added, "If the AI production revolution and capital market reforms work together, key supply chain nodes become new sources of growth, and the three mega projects boost production capacity itself, South Korea could go from being the country that most faithfully followed Japan's path to the one that first breaks away from it." (김 실장은 “이번 반전을 반도체 하나로만 설명하면 가장 중요한 부분을 놓친다”며 정부가 발표한 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’와 상법 개정, 자사주 제도 개편, 국민성장펀드 등의 정책을 거론했다. 그러면서 “AI 생산혁명과 자본시장 개혁이 함께 작동하고, 공급망의 핵심 노드가 새로운 성장의 원천이 되며, 3대 메가 프로젝트가 생산능력 자체를 다시 끌어올린다면 한국은 일본의 길을 가장 충실히 따라온 나라에서, 그 길을 가장 먼저 벗어나는 나라가 될 수도 있다”고 했다.)

Chief Kim also posted on Facebook the previous day, saying, "Semiconductor fabs are not just production facilities but hubs where national industrial capabilities are built," and "The state has a responsibility to establish the industrial foundation for (corporate) competitiveness to be realized." He emphasized the need for a national-level speed strategy, stating, "Removing bottlenecks in power, water, transmission networks, permits, and industrial infrastructure so that companies can secure production capacity as quickly as possible—that is the role only the state can play." (김 실장은 전날에도 페이스북에 “반도체 팹은 생산시설인 동시에 국가 산업 역량이 쌓이는 거점”이라며 “국가는 (기업의) 경쟁력이 발휘될 수 있는 산업 기반을 구축할 책임이 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “기업이 가장 빠르게 생산능력을 확보할 수 있도록 전력과 용수, 송전망과 인허가, 산업 인프라의 병목을 제거하는 것, 그것이 국가만이 할 수 있는 역할”이라며 국가 차원의 속도전 필요성을 거듭 강조했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Hits Back at Kim Min-seok: “Worst Kind of Self-Serving Politics is Leaving the Party and Running as an Independent” (정청래 “최악의 자기정치는 탈당·무소속 출마” 김민석에 반격)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae Hits Back at Kim Min-seok: “Worst Kind of Self-Serving Politics is Leaving the Party and Running as an Independent” (정청래 “최악의 자기정치는 탈당·무소속 출마” 김민석에 반격)

Former Democratic Party of Korea leader Jung Cheong-rae directly refuted criticism of “self-serving politics” raised during the competition for party leadership. (정청래 전 더불어민주당 대표가 당권 경쟁 과정에서 제기된 ‘자기 정치’ 비판에 정면으로 반박했다.)

On the 12th, Jung wrote on Facebook, “The worst kind of self-serving politics is the outdated practice of leaving the party during elections to run as an independent or supporting a candidate from another party. Even when I was unjustly cut from nominations, I led the ‘Bigger Victory Campaign’ for the party’s success and prioritized the party before myself.” He added, “Who has been engaging in self-serving politics?” (정 전 대표는 12일 페이스북에 “최악의 자기정치는 선거 때 탈당해서 무소속 출마하거나 남의 당 후보를 돕는 구태정치”라며 “나는 억울한 컷오프로 공천 탈락했어도 당의 승리를 위해 더컸유세단을 이끌며 뛰었다. 선당후사했다”고 적었다. 이어 “누가 자기정치를 했는가”라고 했다.)

Jung’s post came as the race for party leadership heats up ahead of the August 17 Democratic Party convention, with contenders including former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil. After former PM Kim criticized Jung, saying, “The damage from your self-serving politics over the past year has thrown party-government cooperation into confusion,” the two sides have been locked in a debate over “self-serving politics.” (정 전 대표의 글은 8·17 민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 김민석 전 국무총리, 송영길 의원 등과 당권 경쟁이 본격화하는 가운데 나왔다. 김 전 총리가 정 전 대표를 겨냥해 “지난 1년 자기 정치의 폐해가 당과 당정 협력을 혼선에 빠뜨렸다”고 비판한 뒤 양측의 공방은 ‘자기 정치’ 논쟁으로 번졌다.)

In recent public remarks and social media posts, Jung has emphasized his role as someone who stayed with the Democratic Party without leaving. During a lecture at Chosun University in Gwangju on the 10th, he stated, “I was the one who protected President Lee Jae-myung, and Jung Cheong-rae is the one who will protect him to the end.” He also promoted a so-called “four-fold integration,” encompassing supporters of Presidents Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung, highlighting the party’s legitimacy and unity. (정 전 대표는 최근 공개 발언과 SNS를 통해 자신이 민주당을 떠나지 않고 당을 지켜온 인물이라는 점을 부각하고 있다. 그는 10일 광주 조선대 강연에서도 “이재명 대통령을 지킨 것도 저고, 끝까지 지킬 사람도 정청래”라고 말했다. 또 김대중·노무현·문재인·이재명 대통령 지지층을 아우르는 이른바 ‘4통 통합’을 내세우며 당내 정통성과 결속을 강조했다.)

Former PM Kim has focused on party-government cooperation and a pragmatic, livelihood-centered approach. In his campaign declaration, he emphasized “complete party-government alignment and a pragmatic, integrated livelihood-focused line,” indirectly criticizing Jung’s leadership for failing to effectively translate government support into party approval and electoral outcomes. Lawmaker Song Young-gil also took a veiled swipe at Jung, saying, “We need to elect a leader who will cooperate with the Lee Jae-myung administration, not just a flashy one.” (김 전 총리는 당정 협력과 민생 실용 노선을 앞세우고 있다. 그는 출마 선언에서 “완벽한 당정 일치와 민생실용 통합 노선”을 강조했고, 정 전 대표 체제에서 국정 지지가 정당 지지와 선거 결과로 충분히 연결되지 못했다는 취지로 비판했다. 송영길 의원도 “선명한 사람 아닌 이재명 정부와 협력할 대표를 뽑아야 한다”며 정 전 대표를 우회적으로 겨냥했다.)

The leadership race is also intertwined with a debate over election rules. Within and outside the Democratic Party, tensions are rising between Jung’s camp and other candidates over whether to introduce a preferential voting system. Jung expressed discomfort with what he described as a “two-against-one or three-against-one” dynamic aimed at checking him, while Song countered, “It’s not right for a player on the field to complain about the rules.” (당권 경쟁은 선거 룰 논쟁과도 맞물려 있다. 민주당 안팎에서는 선호투표제 도입 여부를 두고 친청계와 다른 주자들 사이의 신경전이 이어지고 있다. 정 전 대표는 자신을 향한 견제 구도를 ‘2대 1, 3대 1’ 구도로 표현하며 불편한 기색을 드러냈고, 송 의원은 “경기장에 선 선수가 룰을 문제 삼는 것은 옳은 태도가 아니다”라고 맞섰다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Election Commission spent billions of won annually without budget or settlement ([단독] 선관위, 예·결산도 없이 연 수백억원 마음대로 썼다)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Election Commission spent billions of won annually without budget or settlement ([단독] 선관위, 예·결산도 없이 연 수백억원 마음대로 썼다)

The National Election Commission (NEC) has been spending hundreds of millions to billions of won annually without legal grounds, using money not recorded in the national budget or settlement, until it faced a corrective request from the National Assembly. (선거관리위원회가 국가의 예산·결산에 잡히지 않는 돈을 매년 수억~수백억원씩 법적 근거도 없이 집행해 오다가 국회의 시정 요구를 받았다.)

According to the 2025 fiscal year settlement analysis report released by the National Assembly Budget Office (NABO) on the 10th, the NEC has been managing elections for public organizations upon their request, as stipulated by laws such as the Consignment Election Act. These elections include those for the heads and presidents of central associations and cooperatives like Nonghyup, Suhyup, Forestry Cooperatives, and Credit Unions, as well as university president elections and elections for the Korean Sport & Olympic Committee and local sports councils. (국회예산정책처(예정처)가 지난 10일 공개한 2025회계연도 결산 분석 보고서에 따르면, 선관위는 위탁선거법 등 법령에 따라 공공 단체의 위탁을 받아 해당 단체의 선거를 관리해 왔다. 농협·수협·산림조합·신협의 중앙회장 및 조합장 선거, 대학 총장 선거, 대한체육회·지방체육회 선거 등이 선관위의 위탁 관리를 받는다.)

However, the NEC has not included most of the money it receives and spends for these "consignment elections" in its own budget or settlement. Last year, the cost incurred by the NEC for managing 1,190 consigned elections was a mere 128 million won in its settlement. This amounts to about 107,600 won per election. Yet, the NABO confirmed that the NEC actually spent 22.439 billion won on managing these elections for various public organizations last year. Only 0.57% of the actual spending was recorded in the "NEC's ledger." The NABO stated that 22.311 billion won in 2025, 700 million won in 2024, 34.002 billion won in 2023, 2.387 billion won in 2022, and 908 million won in 2021 were executed without being included in the NEC's budget or settlement. (그런데 선관위는 이런 ‘위탁 선거’를 해주고 받은 돈과 쓴 돈 대부분을 선관위 예산·결산에 포함시키지 않고 있다. 지난해 선관위가 각종 선거 1190건을 위탁받아 관리해주는 데 들인 비용은 선관위 결산상으로는 단 1억2800만원에 불과했다. 선거 1건당 약 10만7600원을 썼다는 것이다. 그러나 예정처가 확인해 보니, 선관위가 지난해 각종 공공 단체의 선거를 위탁받아 관리해주는 데 실제로 쓴 돈은 224억3900만원에 달했다. 선관위가 실제로 쓴 돈의 0.57%만이 ‘선관위 가계부’에 적힌 것이다. 예정처는 지난해 223억1100만원, 2024년 7억원, 2023년 340억200만원, 2022년 23억8700만원, 2021년 9억800만원이 선관위 예산·결산에 포함되지 않은 채로 집행됐다고 밝혔다.)

It is a fundamental principle that all revenue and expenditure collected or earned by state agencies, including the NEC, must be included in the budget and settlement. This allows for oversight and control by the National Assembly and the Board of Audit and Inspection. Maintaining a separate "pocket" outside of revenue and expenditure is only permitted in extremely exceptional cases, such as "excess expenditure over revenue-substituting expenses," "in-kind contributions," or "on-lending." Yet, the NEC has been operating hundreds of billions of won in consignment election expenses without any legal basis and free from any oversight. (선관위를 비롯한 국가 기관이 걷거나 벌어들인 돈(세입)과 쓴 돈(세출)은 모두 예산·결산에 포함돼야 하는 것이 기본 원칙이다. 그래야 국회와 감사원으로부터 예산·결산에 대한 통제와 감시를 받기 때문이다. 세입·세출 외로 ‘딴 주머니’를 차는 것은 ‘수입 대체 경비 초과 지출’ ‘현물 출자’ ‘전대차관’ 등 극히 예외적인 경우에만 허용된다. 그런데 선관위만 법령상 근거도 없이 위탁 선거 관련 경비 수백억원을 누구의 통제도 받지 않고 운영해온 것이다.)

The NABO pointed out that "because consignment election expenses are operated outside the revenue and expenditure budget, they are excluded from the National Assembly's budget and settlement review." It added, "Although the Consignment Election Act was amended on August 14, 2025, requiring the NEC to submit settlement reports for consignment election expenses to the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee, this still falls short of the transparency level of the revenue and expenditure budget disclosed to the general public." In fact, detailed breakdowns of the money spent by the NEC for consignment election expenses are not disclosed to the public. (예정처는 “위탁 선거 경비가 세입·세출 예산 외로 운영되다 보니, 국회의 예결산 심사 대상에서 벗어나 있다”고 지적했다. 또 “2025년 8월 14일 위탁선거법이 개정돼 (선관위가) 국회 행정안전위원회에 위탁 선거 경비 결산서 등을 제출하고는 있으나, 일반 국민에게 공개되는 세입·세출 예산 수준의 투명성에는 미치지 못한다”고 했다. 실제로 선관위가 위탁 선거 경비 명목으로 쓴 돈의 세부 내역은 일반 국민에게 공개되지 않고 있다.)

Cases have already been uncovered within the NEC where consignment election expenses were used carelessly, as if they were unaccounted money. According to the NABO, the Chungbuk Provincial Election Commission executed over 23 billion won in consignment election expenses without proper reporting or approval procedures, which was discovered during an audit by the National Election Commission last year. There were also over 480 instances of officials falsifying or forging payment resolution documents. Monthly settlements or accounting document arrangements were either not done on time or were entirely skipped. (이미 선관위 내에서는 위탁 선거 경비를 눈먼 돈처럼 쓴 사례가 적발되고 있다. 예정처에 따르면, 충북선관위는 위탁 선거 경비를 정당한 보고나 결재 절차 없이 230억원 넘게 집행했다가 지난해 중앙선관위 감사에 적발됐다. 담당자가 지급 결의서를 변조하거나 허위로 작성한 경우도 480여 차례 있었다. 월말 결산이나 회계 서류 정리도 제때 하지 않았고, 아예 건너뛴 경우도 있었다.)

The NEC first receives a lump sum for consignment election expenses from the public organizations that entrust election management to it, then uses the funds arbitrarily and returns the remainder. This creates a structure where it is difficult for outsiders to detect or prevent the NEC from retaining a portion of the expenses as profit or diverting funds elsewhere. While the NEC reported spending 22.311 billion won on consignment election expenses outside its revenue and expenditure last year, it actually received 38.835 billion won from public organizations and returned 16.524 billion won. It is unclear whether the full 22.311 billion won was genuinely used for consignment election management. (선관위는 위탁 선거 경비를 선관위에 선거 관리를 위탁하는 공공 단체로부터 먼저 총액으로 받은 뒤, 이를 임의로 사용하고 남은 돈을 돌려주고 있다. 선관위가 경비 일부를 수익처럼 남기거나 다른 곳으로 빼돌려 쓰더라도 이를 외부에서 알고 막기가 어려운 구조다. 선관위는 지난해 세입·세출 외 위탁 선거 경비로 223억1100만원을 쓴 것으로 돼 있지만, 실제로 공공 단체로부터 받은 경비는 388억3500만원이었고, 돌려준 금액은 165억2400만원이었다. 223억1100만원이 온전히 위탁 선거 관리에 쓰였는지는 알 수 없다.)

The NEC has argued that operating consignment election expenses outside the revenue and expenditure budget, as currently done, is "inevitable," citing reasons such as "the difficulty of determining the budget size during the budget formulation and review stages due to the nature of consignment elections" and "issues with carrying over expenses when an election spans two years." A bill has even been proposed in the National Assembly to legalize the NEC's practice of excluding consignment election expenses from the budget and settlement. (선관위는 “위탁 선거의 특성상 예산안 편성·심의 단계에서 예산 규모를 확정하기가 어렵다” “선거 기간이 두 해에 걸쳐 있는 경우 경비를 이월 처리해야 하는 문제가 있다” 등의 이유를 들어 지금처럼 위탁 선거 경비를 세입·세출에 포함시키지 않은 채로 운영하는 것이 “불가피하다”고 주장했다고 한다. 국회에는 선관위가 위탁 선거 경비를 예산·결산에 포함시키지 않는 것을 합법화해주자는 법안도 발의돼 있다.)

However, the NABO rejected the NEC's arguments, stating, "The claim that it is difficult to formulate a budget due to low predictability is unpersuasive. For expenses spanning two years, the budget can be formulated over two years or systems like carryover can be utilized, just as with other expenses." (그러나 예정처는 “예측 가능성이 낮다는 이유로 예산을 편성하는 것이 어렵다는 주장은 설득력이 낮고, 선거가 두 해에 걸쳐 있는 경비의 경우 다른 경비와 마찬가지로 예산을 두 해에 걸쳐 편성하거나 (첫 해에 쓰고 남은 예산을 이듬해로) 이월시키는 제도를 활용할 수 있다”며 선관위의 주장을 받아들이지 않았다.)

The NABO pointed out to the NEC that "to ensure fiscal transparency and accountability, and to contribute to strengthening the National Assembly's fiscal control authority on behalf of the people, consignment election expenses should be included in the national finances and operated under items such as 'revenue-substituting expenses.'" (예정처는 선관위에 “위탁 선거 경비를 국가 재정에 포함되도록 ‘수입 대체 경비’ 등의 항목으로 운용해야 재정의 투명성과 책임성을 확보하고 국민을 대표하는 국회의 재정 통제 권한 강화에 기여할 수 있을 것”이라고 지적했다.)

item.title: Military: "One Navy Ship Crew Member Missing in East Sea…Search Underway" (軍 “동해서 해군 함정 승조원 1명 실종…수색 중”)
item.description:
Military: "One Navy Ship Crew Member Missing in East Sea…Search Underway" (軍 “동해서 해군 함정 승조원 1명 실종…수색 중”)

A crew member of a Navy ship, which was on patrol duty in the northern waters of the East Sea, went missing on the 12th, and military authorities are conducting a search. (동해 북단 해상에서 경비 임무 중이던 해군 함정 승조원 1명이 12일 실종돼 군 당국이 수색 중이다.)

The Navy stated on the 12th, "One crew member (a soldier) from a Navy ship on patrol duty went missing this morning in waters approximately 50 km east of Geojin in the East Sea." (해군은 12일 “오늘 오전 동해 거진 동방 50여㎞해상에서 경비 임무 수행 중인 해군 함정 승조원(병사) 1명이 실종됐다”고 밝혔다.)

The missing soldier is a private first class, and the ship he was aboard is known to be a frigate. (실종된 병사는 일병이며 승선한 함정은 호위함으로 알려졌다.)

The Navy reported, "We are currently conducting a search for the missing person by deploying ships and aircraft in coordination with the Coast Guard," adding, "We have also disseminated the situation to fishing vessels operating nearby and merchant ships in the vicinity, requesting their cooperation in the search." (해군은 “현재 해경과 합동으로 함정과 항공기를 투입하여 실종자를 탐색 중”이라며 “조업 중인 어선, 인근 상선 등에도 상황을 전파하고 수색을 협조하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

The disappearance has reportedly been notified to North Korea as well, through international maritime common networks that are accessible to the North. (실종 사실은 북한도 수신이 가능한 국제상선공통망 등을 통해 북측에도 통지된 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Discloses Prescription...To Lee Seong-yoon: "Keep Raising Issues? That's Just Like a 'Daejang-dong Prosecutor'" (처방전 공개한 김민석...이성윤에 “계속 문제제기? 대장동 검사 같은 짓” )
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, a former Prime Minister running in the Democratic Party's next leadership election, directly disclosed his prescription to counter the offensive from the pro-Chung (pro-Jung Cheong-rae) faction, which had demanded he "reveal the ingredients of the cold medicine" he took on the day of the December 3rd martial law declaration. <<> During the "100 Questions, 100 Answers from YouTubers" event held at the National Assembly on the 12th, former PM Kim stated, "Rep. Lee Seong-yoon, who is not a pharmacist but a former prosecutor, seems very interested in drug ingredients," and disclosed the hospital prescription and medication prescription from the day of the martial law. Earlier, pro-Chung supreme council member Lee Seong-yoon had raised suspicions about Kim's absence from the vote to lift martial law, demanding, "You said you took cold medicine, so reveal its ingredients." <<> Former PM Kim explained, "I had a sore throat and body aches, so I went to the hospital, got an IV drip, received medication, and went to sleep that night." He added, "Later, my aides came and woke me up. I went to the National Assembly, climbed over the wall, entered, and as soon as I sat down, Chairman (Lee Jae-myung) next to me said, 'I just pressed the (voting) button.'" Kim further revealed in detail that while heading to the Assembly, he had posted on Facebook and in the National Assembly member group chat that "the martial law was a criminal act blatantly violating the Constitution and laws," and had also asked Baek Tae-woong, South Korea's ambassador to the OECD, to help draft an English statement. <<> Former PM Kim asserted, "Bringing this up further now is cheating," adding, "The issue of apologizing or not depends on their conscience. If one cannot say such things, I believe they are unqualified for politics." He continued, "I've even shown the drug ingredients," and warned, "If the issue is clear and yet they keep raising it, that's just like a 'Daejang-dong prosecutor'." <<> Meanwhile, regarding his reason for running, former PM Kim stated, "I am the best-prepared person to support the president's governance for the next two years." He added, "We must win the (2028) general election. Among the candidates expected to run for party leader, Kim Min-seok has the most experience in election strategy and command, and also has actual winning results." <<> Regarding the pro-Chung faction's attack that he delayed the decision to abolish supplementary investigative powers, former PM Kim responded, "I conveyed to the party the opinion that it should be wrapped up before May. It was the party that delayed processing it within May for various reasons (such as general elections)." He added, "Regarding the reasons for the delay, I will (disclose them through various processes) in the future if necessary," shifting responsibility to the Jung Cheong-rae leadership. <<> On the failed merger with the Rebuilding Korea Party (Cho Kuk Innovation Party), he stated, "Former leader Jung Cheong-rae failed to achieve the merger. That's because he ignored the procedures and excluded deliberation and discussion." He added, "If the merger was so necessary, former leader Jung bears significant responsibility for not succeeding in it." item.title: Lee Jun-seok Targets People Power Party: "Suspicion of Election Manipulation by Jeong I-han... If True, It's Over" (이준석, 국민의힘 겨냥 “정이한 선거 공작 의혹…사실이면 끝장”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok Targets People Power Party: "Suspicion of Election Manipulation by Jeong I-han... If True, It's Over" (이준석, 국민의힘 겨냥 “정이한 선거 공작 의혹…사실이면 끝장”)

Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, denied any prior knowledge regarding the staged terrorist incident involving former Reform Party Busan mayoral candidate Jeong I-han, instead raising suspicions of the People Power Party's involvement. (이준석 개혁신당 대표가 정이한 전 개혁신당 부산시장 후보의 테러 자작극과 관련해 사전 인지설을 부인하면서 오히려 국민의힘의 관여 의혹을 제기했다.)

In a Facebook post on the night of the 11th, Lee stated, "Jeong I-han is someone who worked as an aide for the People Power Party," adding, "I don't know who in the People Power Party orchestrated this during the election, or whether reckless elements are stirring things up." (이 대표는 11일 밤 페이스북 글에서 “정이한은 국민의힘에서 보좌진으로 일했던 사람”이라면서 “이번 선거에서 국민의힘에서 누가 공작해서 이 일이 생겼는지 알고 불나방들이 설치는지 모르겠다”고 말했다.)

Lee further said, "It's not that I'm keeping quiet because I don't know who in the People Power Party approached Jeong I-han and planted strange ideas in his head," and added, "If someone from a certain candidate's camp made an unusual proposal to Jeong I-han, you people are finished." (이 대표는 “국민의힘에서 누가 정이한에게 접근해서 그에게 이상한 마음을 품게 했는지 몰라서 말 안 하는 게 아니다”라면서 “만약에 모 후보 캠프에서 정이한에게 이상한 제안을 했으면 귀하들은 끝장”이라고 했다.)

This implies that the People Power Party, which had proposed a candidate unification to former candidate Jeong during the Busan mayoral election, may have influenced the decision to stage the terrorist incident. (부산시장 선거 과정에서 정 전 후보에게 단일화를 제안했던 국민의힘이 테러 자작극 결정에 영향을 끼쳤을 것이란 취지다.)

Former candidate Jeong had claimed he was the victim of a beverage terrorist attack during the Busan mayoral election, but it was later revealed to be a staged incident. He was arrested on the 8th. (정 전 후보는 부산시장 선거 당시 음료 테러 사건을 당했다고 주장했으나 이후 자작극이었음이 드러났다. 정 전 후보는 지난 8일 구속됐다.)

Some within the People Power Party subsequently raised suspicions that Lee may have had prior knowledge of the terrorist allegations against former candidate Jeong. Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon also said on the 10th, "Reveal whether the police and the Reform Party knew about this in advance." (이후 국민의힘 일각에선 이 대표가 정 전 후보의 테러 의혹을 사전에 알았을 수 있다는 의혹을 제기했다. 무소속 한동훈 후보도 지난 10일 “경찰과 개혁신당이 사전에 알고 있었는지 밝혀라”라고 했다.)

In response, Lee stated on the 10th, "I had no idea (before the local elections)," adding, "There's no way someone like that would have told us, and the police have said they didn't officially notify us. We couldn't have known." <<>> (이 대표는 이에 대해 “(지방선거 전에) 전혀 몰랐다”면서 “그런 사람이 저희에게 얘기해 줬을 리도 만무하고 경찰이 공식적으로 저희에게 통보를 안 했다고 하지 않았나. 인지할 수 없었다”고 지난 10일 말했다.)

item.title: Lee Seok-yeon: "Complete Abolition of Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigative Powers Is Unconstitutional" (이석연 “검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지는 위헌”)
item.description:
Lee Seok-yeon: "Complete Abolition of Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigative Powers Is Unconstitutional" (이석연 “검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지는 위헌”)

Lee Seok-yeon, chief of the presidential committee on national unity, said on the 12th that “the complete abolition of prosecutors’ supplementary investigative powers is unconstitutional.” This is because the complete abolition of these powers, pursued by the Democratic Party of Korea, fundamentally denies the ‘prosecutors’ investigative authority’ as stipulated by the Constitution. (이석연 대통령 직속 국민통합위원장은 12일 “검사의 보완수사권 완전 폐지는 헌법에 위배된다”고 했다. 더불어민주당이 추진하는 검사의 보완 수사권 완전 폐지가, 헌법이 규정한 ‘검사의 수사권’을 전면 부정하고 있어서 위헌이라는 것이다.)

In a statement issued that day, Chairman Lee stated, “Although the Constitution does not prevent the abolition of the prosecution office itself to disperse prosecutors’ powers, entirely stripping prosecutors of their investigative authority as the primary investigative body goes against the principle of constitutional systemic legitimacy and has elements of unconstitutionality.” (이 위원장은 이날 입장문을 통해 “헌법은 비록 검찰청을 폐지하여 검사의 권한을 분산하는 것까지는 막고 있지 않지만, 수사의 주체로서의 검사가 가진 수사권의 완전 박탈은 헌법의 체계 정당성의 원리에 반하여 위헌의 소지가 있다”고 했다.)

Chairman Lee pointed out that the current Constitution (Article 12, Paragraph 3; Article 16) designates the application for warrants necessary for arrest, detention, seizure, and search as the exclusive and sole authority of prosecutors. He argued, “To completely abolish prosecutors’ investigative powers, the Constitution must be amended to change the warrant application authority, as in the first Constitution, from prosecutors to investigative agencies, or it must be delegated to law.” The complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers, he noted, amounts to denying the investigative authority of prosecutors, who are the subjects of warrant applications, making it unconstitutional. (이 위원장은 현행 헌법(12조 3항, 16조)이 체포·구속·압수·수색 등에 필요한 영장의 신청을 검사의 독점적·배타적 권한으로 규정하고 있다는 점을 지적하며 “검사의 수사권을 완전 박탈하기 위해서는 헌법을 개정하여 영장신청권을 제헌헌법처럼 검사 대신 수사기관으로 고치든지 아니면 법률에 위임해야 한다”고 했다. 보완수사권의 완전 폐지는, 영장 신청의 주체인 검사의 수사권을 인정하지 않는 것이기 때문에 위헌이라는 것이다.)

Chairman Lee stated, “Not only for the protection of victims, the discovery of substantive truth, and the swift realization of justice in criminal law, but also to uphold the spirit of the Constitution, prosecutors’ supplementary investigative powers must be recognized in some form.” He then directly criticized the Democratic Party, adding, “Responsible political parties should not abandon the basic principles for the future of the community in the name of reform, clinging to the immediate approval of their support base or party interests.” (이 위원장은 “피해자 보호, 실체적 진실 발견, 형사 사법의 신속한 정의 실현이라는 차원에서 뿐만 아니라 헌법의 정신을 지키기 위해서도 검사의 보완 수사권은 어떤 형태로든지 인정되어야 한다고 본다”고 했다. 이어 “책임 있는 공당이라면 당장의 지지층의 눈치나 당리당략에 매달려 개혁이라는 이름으로 공동체의 미래를 위한 기본 원칙을 저버려서는 아니된다”고 민주당을 직격했다.)

Chairman Lee also said, “The system itself has no inherent good or evil,” and “regardless of the system, it’s a matter of the people who operate it.” He added, “The issue of prosecutors’ supplementary investigative powers should also be discussed in that context.” (이 위원장은 “제도 그 자체는 선악이 없다”며 “어떤 제도가 됐든 그 제도를 운영하는 사람의 문제”라고도 했다. 그러면서 “검사의 보완 수사권 문제도 그런 차원에서 논의되어야 한다”고 했다.)

Chairman Lee expressed, “Furthermore, I earnestly hope that the pressing issues of our society, which are heading toward severe national division, will be discussed and resolved based on legal stability and predictability, in accordance with the Constitution and sound public common sense.” He concluded, “This is the way to realize the political justice pursued by the Constitution and the path to achieving social integration.” (이 위원장은 “나아가 심각한 국론 분열로 치닫고 있는 우리 사회의 현안들이 법적 안정성과 예측 가능성을 바탕으로 헌법과 건전한 국민 상식에 따라 논의되고 해결되기를 간절히 기대한다”며 “그것이 헌법이 추구하는 정치적 정의를 실현하는 길이자 사회 통합을 이루는 길”이라고 했다.)

Chairman Lee is a centrist conservative figure who served as the Minister of Government Legislation during the Lee Myung-bak administration. President Lee Jae-myung recruited him during the last presidential election and appointed him as a co-chair of the joint election committee. After the government was launched, he was selected as the chief of the presidential committee on national unity. (이 위원장은 이명박 정부에서 법제처장을 지낸 중도 보수 인사다. 이재명 대통령은 지난 대선 때 이 위원장을 영입해 공동선거대책위원장에 임명했다. 정부 출범 뒤 국민통합위원장에 발탁됐다.)

item.title: Unification Ministry Requests North Korea's Cooperation in Search and Repatriation of Missing Navy Soldier in East Sea (통일부, 동해 해군장병 실종에 “수색·송환 관련 대북 협조 요청”)
item.description:
The Unification Ministry stated on the 12th that it has requested North Korea's cooperation in search and repatriation efforts, in case a missing navy soldier from the East Sea's northern waters may have drifted north of the Northern Limit Line (NLL). (통일부는 12일 동해 북단 해상에서 실종된 해군 장병이 북방한계선(NLL) 이북 지역으로 표류했을 가능성에 대비해 북한에 수색·송환 협조를 요청한다고 밝혔다.)

In a press notice issued that day, the Unification Ministry announced, "One navy soldier aboard a naval vessel conducting patrol duties in the East Sea has gone missing and appears to have possibly drifted into areas north of the NLL," adding, "We have requested North Korea's cooperation from a humanitarian perspective in the search and repatriation of the missing personnel." (통일부는 이날 ‘언론 공지’를 통해 “동해 해상에서 경비 임무 수행 중인 해군 함정 병사 1명이 실종돼 NLL(북방한계선) 이북 지역으로 표류 가능성이 있는 것으로 보인다”며 “인도주의적 견지에서 실종자 수색과 송환에 (북한이) 협조해주기를 요청했다”고 밝혔다.)

The Unification Ministry explained that since all communication channels with North Korea are currently severed, the cooperation request is being conveyed through the media. (통일부는 현재 대북 소통 채널이 모두 단절돼 언론을 통해 협조요청 메시지를 전달하는 것이라고 설명했다.)

Earlier, the Navy reported, "A crew member (soldier) from a naval vessel conducting patrol duties in the waters approximately 50 km east of Geojin-eup, Goseong-gun, in the East Sea this morning has gone missing." (앞서 해군은 이날 “오늘 오전 동해 고성군 거진읍 동방 50여㎞ 해상에서 경비 임무 수행 중인 해군 함정 승조원(병사) 1명이 실종됐다”고 밝혔다.)

The Navy, in coordination with the Coast Guard, has deployed vessels and aircraft to search for the missing soldier. (해군은 해경과 합동으로 함정과 항공기 등을 투입해 실종된 병사를 탐색 중이다.)

item.title: First ROK-U.S. Joint Tabletop Exercise Conducted to Block 'Disinformation' in Crises (유사시 ‘허위정보’ 유포 차단…첫 한미 합동 도상훈련 실시)
item.description:
As the importance of 'cognitive warfare'—spreading false information to disrupt an adversary's judgment and public sentiment, as seen in recent conflicts like the Ukraine war—draws attention, South Korea and the United States have recently conducted their first joint tabletop exercise (TTX) to counter such threats. (최근 우크라이나 전쟁 등에서 허위 정보를 퍼트려 상대국의 판단과 민심을 교란하는 ‘인지전’의 중요성이 주목받는 가운데, 최근 한미가 처음으로 이런 위협에 대응하는 연합 도상 훈련(TTX)을 실시했다.)

Cognitive warfare refers to a method of warfare that fosters false perceptions among an adversary's leadership or public to induce psychological turmoil or strategic errors. (인지전이란 상대 국가의 지도부나 대중에게 잘못된 인식을 조장해 심리적 동요나 전략적 실수를 유도하는 전쟁 수행 방식을 뜻한다.)

According to ROK-U.S. military authorities on the 12th, the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS), U.S. Forces Korea (USFK), the ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command, and the United Nations Command hosted a ROK-U.S. 'Interagency Strategic Communication Response Tabletop Exercise' at the JCS building in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, on the 9th. (12일 한미 군 당국에 따르면 합동참모본부와 주한미군, 한미연합군사령부, 유엔군사령부는 지난 9일 서울 용산구 합참 청사에서 한미 ‘정부기관 연계 전략적 소통 대응 도상 훈련’을 주최했다.)

This exercise, organized under the leadership of the JCS, involved numerous domestic government agencies, including the Ministry of National Defense, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, Ministry of Science and ICT, Korea Communications Commission, National Intelligence Service, and National Police Agency. It was reported that each agency introduced its roles related to communication strategies in crisis situations and coordinated effective response measures. (합참 주도로 마련된 이번 훈련에는 국방부, 외교부, 문화체육관광부, 과학기술정보통신부, 방송미디어통신위원회, 국가정보원, 경찰청 등 국내 정부 기관도 다수 참여했다. 각 기관은 유사시 소통 전략 등과 관련해 각자가 하는 역할을 소개하고 효과적 대응 방안을 조율한 것으로 전해졌다.)

While coordination meetings among relevant agencies to counter wartime disinformation had been held before, this is understood to be the first time ROK-U.S. military authorities and related government agencies have gathered broadly for a tabletop exercise. (이전에도 전시 허위 정보에 대응하는 유관 기관 협조 회의 등은 개최된 적이 있지만, 한미 군 당국과 관련 정부 기관이 폭넓게 모여 도상훈련을 한 것은 이번이 처음으로 알려졌다.)

USFK explained that the exercise was held considering the critical role of the information environment in modern conflict, describing it in a press release as "the first comprehensive combined, interagency, and multinational exercise specifically focused on synchronizing operations within the information environment." (주한미군은 현대 분쟁에서 정보 환경이 지니는 중요한 역할을 고려해 이번 훈련이 개최됐다며 “정보 환경 내 작전의 동기화에 구체적으로 초점을 맞춘 최초의 종합적 연합·범정부·다국적 훈련”이라고 보도자료를 통해 설명했다.)

According to USFK, the tabletop exercise focused on discussions in areas including: ▲ Countering foreign disinformation ▲ Synchronizing responses to multi-domain threats such as cyber, space, and the electromagnetic spectrum ▲ Aligning strategic communication. (주한미군에 따르면 이번 도상훈련에서는 ▲ 해외 허위 정보(disinformation) 대응 ▲ 사이버·우주·전자기 스펙트럼 등 다영역 위협 대응 동기화 ▲ 전략적 소통 조율(alignment) 등 분야가 중점적으로 논의됐다.)

The decision by South Korea and the U.S. to hold such an event is interpreted as a response to the recent evolution of the battlefield, where cognitive warfare using non-physical means like social media has emerged as a critical factor. (한미가 이런 자리를 마련한 것은 최근 전장 환경 변화에 따라 소셜미디어 등 비물리적 수단을 무기로 한 인지전이 중요한 요소로 부상하고 있기 때문으로 해석된다.)

Military authorities are reported to be considering applying the discussions from this exercise to more specific scenarios during the upcoming ROK-U.S. joint exercise 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' (UFS) next month. (군 당국은 이번에 논의한 내용을 다음 달 개최될 한미연합훈련 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS·을지프리덤실드)에서 보다 구체적인 시나리오에 적용해 보는 방안도 검토하는 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: People Power Party Demands Dismissal of Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, Calling Him "The Mastermind Behind the 'Squid Game' Stock Market" (국힘, 김용범 정책실장 경질 요구 “‘오징어 게임’ 증시 주범”)
item.description:
People Power Party Demands Dismissal of Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, Calling Him "The Mastermind Behind the 'Squid Game' Stock Market" (국힘, 김용범 정책실장 경질 요구 “‘오징어 게임’ 증시 주범”)

The People Power Party (PPP) claimed that the responsibility for the extreme volatility in the domestic stock market lies with Kim Yong-beom, Cheong Wa Dae's chief of policy, who allowed financial companies to launch single-stock leveraged ETFs (exchange-traded funds). The party demanded that President Lee Jae-myung dismiss Kim. (국민의힘은 국내 주식시장의 변동성이 극심해진 책임이 금융회사들이 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF(상장 지수 펀드)를 출시하게 한 김용범 청와대 정책실장에게 있다고 주장하면서 이재명 대통령에게 김 실장을 경질하라고 요구했다.)

PPP Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon said in a commentary on the 12th, "Last year, there were only nine days when the KOSPI surged or plunged by more than 3% in a single day, but this year, it has already reached 42 days." He pointed out, "In particular, since the launch of single-stock leveraged products, 16 out of 30 trading days have seen repeated spikes and crashes." <<> He added, "Program trading halts every four days, and the entire market freezes about once a month." He remarked, "A 'wag the dog' situation, where the tail of derivatives shakes the body of the stock market, has become routine." He criticized, "This isn't a normal investment market; it's a 'Squid Game' stock market where only those who survive to the end can make money." <<> Senior Spokesperson Choi claimed, "At the starting point of this disastrous situation is Director Kim." He noted, "After holding a private meeting with heads of securities and asset management firms in January, Kim himself revealed that he had raised the issue (of launching single-stock leveraged ETFs) with the Financial Services Commission (FSC) and ordered a review." He pointed out, "And in less than five months, single-stock leveraged ETFs, which previously had no legal basis, were launched. The FSC hastily revised the enforcement decree and regulations, and even industry insiders called it 'unprecedentedly fast.'" <<> He continued, "While there were concerns within financial authorities about increased volatility and market distortion, there are testimonies that they couldn't defy the overwhelming directives from the policy office." He added, "Eventually, all 14 launched products were concentrated on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, and a vicious cycle began where the fluctuations of these two stocks, through mechanical trading, shook the entire market." <<> Senior Spokesperson Choi criticized, "Despite the situation reaching this point, Director Kim, who led the policy, is merely saying, 'If supplementation is needed, it will be decided at the market situation review meeting,' passing the buck to the ministries as if it's someone else's business, without a single word of regret." Choi asked Kim, "Where has the confidence gone, with which you previously dismissed the 'three highs' as the cost of success with constant interference? Are you now hiding like a ghost in the face of the trouble you caused?" He also said, "How else would the head of the Financial Supervisory Service have bowed his head, saying, 'I should have stopped (the launch of single-stock leveraged ETFs) even if it meant lying down on the job?'" He added, "The policy office pushed it through, and the financial authorities caved—this is the reality of Cheong Wa Dae-led government-directed finance, and the main culprit behind retail investors shedding tears of blood." <<> Senior Spokesperson Choi also criticized Kim's policies on real estate and exchange rates, saying, "With a robbing-Peter-to-pay-Paul loan policy, he kicked away the housing ladder by driving the average price of apartments in Seoul to 1.59 billion won, and his remarks tolerating a high exchange rate have cemented the era of 1,500 won per dollar." <<> He further criticized, "He stirs up every market and amplifies chaos, but now that public opinion has worsened, he belatedly says, 'The government doesn't have all the answers,' and plans to hold a forum to adjust the intensity." He denounced this as "a typical diversion tactic to shift the blame for policy failures onto the people and the field." <<> Senior Spokesperson Choi pressed, "What did Director Kim discuss in that private meeting (with heads of securities and asset management firms last January)? Why did he ignore internal opposition and warnings? Why did he rush to open the door for a system that concentrated leveraged products only on the top two stocks by market capitalization?" He asserted, "This dangerous policy experiment, conducted with the people's assets as collateral, cannot be dismissed as a misjudgment or a supplemental task for ministries." <<> Senior Spokesperson Choi urged, "The price for turning the market into a gambling den and making the people shed tears of blood will not be light. Director Kim must apologize directly to the people right now, and President Lee Jae-myung should immediately dismiss Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, holding him heavily accountable for the catastrophic failure his hasty policy has caused." (국민의힘 최보윤 수석대변인은 12일 논평을 통해 “지난해 코스피가 하루 3% 이상 급등락한 날은 9일뿐이었지만, 올해는 벌써 42일에 달한다”며 “특히 단일 종목 레버리지 상품 출시 이후 30거래일 중 16일이나 폭등과 폭락이 반복됐다”고 짚었다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil Begins ‘Honam Sojourn’ for a Month… “I Will Find Answers on the Ground in Honam” (송영길, 한달간 ‘호남살이’ 시작…“호남 현장에서 답 찾겠다”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil Begins ‘Honam Sojourn’ for a Month… “I Will Find Answers on the Ground in Honam” (송영길, 한달간 ‘호남살이’ 시작…“호남 현장에서 답 찾겠다”)

Song Young-gil, a lawmaker challenging for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, announced on the 12th that he will begin a month-long stay in Honam starting today until the end of the party convention on the 17th of next month. (더불어민주당 당권에 도전한 송영길 의원이 전당대회가 끝나는 다음달 17일까지 한달간 호남살이에 돌입한다고 12일 밝혔다.)

Song’s camp said on the same day, “From right after the party convention candidate registration on the 17th until August 17th, when the convention ends, we have decided to reside in Honam, including Gwangju, South Jeolla, and North Jeolla.” (송 의원 측은 이날 “오는 17일 민주당 전당대회 후보등록 직후 부터 전당대회가 끝나는 8.17일까지 광주, 전남,전북 등 호남에 상주하기로 했다”고 했다.)

Explaining the choice of Honam, Song stated, “The first shovel for President Lee Jae-myung’s decisive 800 trillion won semiconductor cluster is being placed in Honam. I decided to find answers at the site of this national project that carries the fate of South Korea, and I will demonstrate a ‘Song Young-gil-style’ approach on the ground.” (호남을 선택한 이유로 “지금 호남에는 이재명 대통령이 결단한 800조 원 반도체 클러스터의 첫 삽이 놓이고 있다”며 “대한민국의 명운이 걸린 국가 프로젝트 현장에서 답을 찾기로 했고, 현장에서 ‘송영길스러움’을 보여드리게될 것”이라고 설명했다.)

Also, referencing the success of the Honam semiconductor cluster, he said, “I am the only candidate among those in the party convention who has served as the head of a metropolitan government. I possess the experience of being the most senior lawmaker in the National Assembly (six terms) and diplomatic capabilities speaking four languages.” He added, “Lawmaker Song, who has dealt with global companies and investments, will find solid success strategies for the semiconductor cluster through his expertise.” (또 호남 반도체 클러스터 성공을 언급하며 “전대 후보중 유일하게 광역단체장을 지냈다”며 “국회 최다선 의원(6선)의 경륜, 4개국어를 구사하는 외교 역량을 갖췄다”고 했다. 그러면서 “글로벌 기업과 투자를 상대해 본 송 의원이 실력으로, 반도체 클러스터의 단단한 성공 방안을 찾아낼 것”이라고 했다.)

Afterwards, Song plans to personally inspect sites such as the military airfield site and Haenam Solar City, and meet with businesses, local governments, universities, and residents to check bottlenecks in water, electricity, land, and manpower one by one.
